ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows an organic transition-state schematic with curved arrows and Greek-letter labels. After ignoring these curved arrows and labels such as α, β, δ, etc., it can be seen that the lower left is a benzene ring; there is a hydroxyl OH substituent on the benzene ring; the benzene-ring carbon ortho to OH is connected to a substituted sp3 carbon. This sp3 carbon is also connected to an ethyl chain to the right, and to an upward vinyl fragment. Reasoning: Keeping only the actual σ/π bond skeleton, the structure is an ortho-hydroxyphenyl connected to a C=CC(CC)- side chain. The aromatic ring can be written as c1ccccc1O, and the side chain is connected at the position ortho to the hydroxyl group, so the overall SMILES is C=CC(CC)c1ccccc1O.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Describe the image first, then ignore all curved arrows and labels such as α, β, and δ. Trace only the sigma/pi-bond skeleton: an aromatic benzene ring has an OH substituent on one carbon and, ortho to it, a substituted sp3 carbon. That sp3 carbon is attached to the ring, to an ethyl branch CC, and to a vinyl fragment C=C. Write the side chain as C=CC(CC)- attached to the ortho-hydroxyphenyl ring, then encode the aromatic ring with the adjacent OH as c1ccccc1O, giving C=CC(CC)c1ccccc1O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图显示一个带有曲箭头和希腊字母标注的有机过渡态示意图。忽略这些曲箭头以及 α、β、δ 等标签后，可以看到左下方是一个苯环；苯环上有一个羟基 OH 取代基；与 OH 邻位的苯环碳连接到一个取代的 sp3 碳。该 sp3 碳还连接一个向右的乙基链，以及一个向上的乙烯基片段。推理：只保留实际的 σ/π 键骨架，该结构是邻羟基苯基连接到 C=CC(CC)- 侧链。芳香环可写为 c1ccccc1O，侧链与羟基邻位连接，因此整体 SMILES 为 C=CC(CC)c1ccccc1O。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES route: it relies on reading the displayed bond-line skeleton and translating the retained atoms/bonds into a canonical-enough SMILES, rather than using reaction-mechanism interpretation.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a bond-line drawing with curved arrows to be ignored. Identify an ortho-substituted phenol: a benzene ring bearing an OH group and, on the adjacent aromatic carbon, a side chain whose benzylic saturated carbon is bonded to the ring, to an ethyl group, and to a vinyl group shown as a C=C unit.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the depicted transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard line-angle chemistry conventions: unlabeled vertices/endpoints are carbons with implicit hydrogens, aromatic benzene is written as c1ccccc1, phenolic OH is represented by O attached to an aromatic carbon, and a terminal alkene side chain is written as C=C. Encode ortho relationship by placing O on the aromatic atom adjacent to the side-chain attachment in the ring SMILES.
